annotation.title_clean: 14 CFR Part 60—Flight Simulation Training Device Initial and Continuing Qualification and Use
annotation.title_en: 14 CFR Part 60—Flight Simulation Training Device Initial and Continuing Qualification and Use
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), U.S. Department of Transportation
annotation.summary_en: US FAA regulation (14 CFR Part 60) setting rules for qualification, sponsorship, evaluation, modification, and continuing use of aircraft flight simulation training devices, with Qualification Performance Standards appendices for airplane and helicopter simulators. It concerns pilot training equipment, not AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sponsors must hold FAA-approved quality management systems and be certificate holders
FSTDs require initial qualification with Statement of Qualification and Master Qualification Test Guide
Continuing qualification evaluations, quarterly inspections and discrepancy logs required
Modifications and FSTD Directives require notification and possible re-evaluation
Qualification is lost automatically if the device is moved or not inspected; restoration procedures apply
